title: Read and write paths
prompt: Design review has a pretty box diagram but nobody can narrate one successful read or write. What do you require before continuing?

choices.label: One happy read and one happy write naming the row each touches
choices.consequence: Paths make ownership and consistency real.

choices.label: Add three more caches first
choices.consequence: Caches without paths hide who fills them.

choices.label: Jump straight to chaos scenarios
choices.consequence: Failure talk without a happy path is ungrounded.

choices.label: Demand full class UML first
choices.consequence: UML without paths still misses runtime truth.
